title: Development of a marker panel for the individualized bDMARD therapy of psoriatic arthritis (Integrate-PsA)
summary:
Psoriatic arthritis is a very heterogeneous group of diseases that generally affect the skin and can often also affect the joints and spine. Numerous approved treatment options are now available. Following the failure of conventional basic therapy, so-called biological basic therapies (bDMARDs) can now be used, in which various cyotokines are addressed. Patients respond very differently to the various cytokine blockades. Good predictors, i.e. factors that can predict the response, are still lacking. Accordingly, all treatment options are equally recommended in the guidelines.
In order to change this, the study aims to identify predictive markers from the skin and blood that could best predict the response even before bDMARD therapy is initiated. For this purpose, one of the three bDMARD groups (TNFi, IL17i or IL23i) will be used in patients who need to be escalated to a bDMARD for clinical indications. Prior to therapy escalation, the biomarkers of interest are obtained (skin and blood). After 16 weeks, the success of the therapy is reviewed. Finally, the biomarkers obtained before the initiation of therapy are evaluated to determine how well they can predict the response to therapy.
The aim of the study is therefore to identify biomarkers or biomarker panels that are as predictive as possible and that can predict which of the currently still equivalent therapy principles is the best possible treatment option for the individual patient in everyday clinical practice in patients who have failed conventional basic therapy. This could save patients from unsuccessful therapies and improve patient care in the long term.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Diagnosis of active PsA (psoriatic arthritis)
- No MDA status (minimal disease activity) after at least 3 months of MTX (methotrexate) treatment
- Clinical indication for treatment escalation from MTX to a b-DMARD (biologic disease-modifying antirheumatic drug)
- Switch to one of the following three biologic classes: TNFi (tumour necrosis factor inhibitor), IL17i (Interleukin 17 Inhibitor) and IL23i (Interleukin 23 Inhibitor)
Exclusion criteria:
- Non-response or intolerance to MTX (methotrexate)
